newsitem.title: USA: Tenet holders file for 6.6 mln common shrs.
newsitem.headline: Tenet holders file for 6.6 mln common shrs.

text.p: Selling shareholders for Tenet HealthCare filed Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration to sell up to 6,634,792 common shares.

The shares were originally issued to Joseph Littlejohn & Levy Fund L.P. (JLL) in connection with the acquisition of OrNda HealthCorp by Tenet in January 1997. JLL will distribute the shares to the shareholders who are limited partners.
The offering will be made through Merrill Lynch & Co, Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, Goldman Sachs & Co and J.P. Morgan & Co.

Selling shareholders include California Public Employees' Retirement System with 1,830,775 shares; Oregon Public Employees' Retirement System with 1,099,435 shares and New York State common retirement Fund with 812,745 shares.
Tenet, based in Santa Barbara, is an investor-owned healthcare services company.
